construction.periodic: Consume MatchedJointCase exact saved aggregate/state lineage and existing preparations; force=ionic_force-positive_gradient; field_gradient from same aggregate; physical C plus ZERO deltaC; no new contractions.
construction.mass: original retains exact original atomic masses. H1/H2 replace all original H atom inertial masses only with saved NIST relative atomic isotope masses; recompute ionic and field Gaussian and canonical p-Za coupling. Original is NOT relabeled H1. Potential, geometry, charge, electronic D and coefficients fixed. Atomic isotope masses used as specified effective ionic inertial masses, not nuclear bare masses.
construction.uncoupled: Explicit alternate CONTROL: N independent copies of a one-cell ionic+field system; retain full intracell C(R=0), remove all intercell C; ONE independent three-polarization field per cell, each with Maxwell volume Vcell and mass Mglobal/N. No global shared field. Each field has its own existing conditional Gaussian at ncells=1; all cell systems product prepared. Thus local a variance is N times global a variance, local Pi variance global Pi/N, and field zero-point energy is multiplied by N. No same-field-state or field-mode-count matching claim. Total volume and energy extensive; summed energy and same-total-energy local/common kicks, common per-cell amplitude local/sqrt(N). Regions mean whole original supercells, not individual atoms.
construction.readout: Original atom IDs and axes; all cells/all coordinates propagate. Selected (u,p) spatial connected ordered equal/two-time covariances and commutator; field and mixed ordered outputs. Baseline/local/common means, same kick energy within each mass/control model. Different mass variants generally have different one-trap-quantum kick energies; no equal-energy cross-isotope claim.

oracle.scope: Only new joins/control normalization. Small finite 2-cell 1-atom anisotropic fixture; independent SymPy scalar Hessian/linear and SciPy finite evolution in real space. Validate exact force/field signs, once-only C, isotope widths/canonical diamagnetism, zero independent-region cross-covariance, field multiplicity/mass normalization and equal total kick energies. Mutation sensitivities required. Do not replay established ClampedArray suite.
oracle.execution: Parent only, no worker numerical execution

limits: Clamped electrons, not coupled electronic E/D results or complete C.
No density/resolution/size convergence, nuclear physics/rates/heat, bath or entanglement inference.
No coefficient error bound added; original matched geometric approximation and nonstationary affine drift retained.
commands: python run_matched_clamped_controls.py --case CASE --mass original --control periodic --oracle /var/tmp/p254-matched-clamped-oracle.json --times 0 1 --reference-time 0 --kick-atom ORIGINAL_ID --kick-axis x --output /var/tmp/p254-CASE-original-periodic --output-max-bytes 268435456
Repeat --control independent-regions for explicit alternate local-field product control. For loaded-ni31h6 or dispersed-ni32h6 repeat --mass H1 and --mass H2 separately; preserve original run.
